title: Burnout 3: Takedown arrives on PlayStation 2
summary: In 2004, Burnout 3: Takedown became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.

blocks.text: In 2004, Burnout 3: Takedown became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the racing category, Burnout 3: Takedown broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
